item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's younger brother Arjun caught chickenpox. It is caused by a virus, and within a few days two other children in his class in Jaipur also fell ill after playing with him. How should this disease be classified?

options.A: Non-communicable, because it is caused by a virus inside the body
options.B: Communicable, because it is caused by a pathogen and spreads from person to person
options.C: Chronic, because it can last for more than a week
options.D: Non-communicable, because it cannot spread through air or water
